# Biscuit

## Description
A post-marmot: a fat, whiskered, serious animal the size of a small dog, with a brass
tag on a collar that reads "LOFT ROUND" and a letter in his mouth. Comes up through
the hearth hatch at 06:02, climbs the stairs, puts the same letter on the fourth bed,
sits back on his haunches, and waits to be paid (a raisin; Wil's). Sighs when nobody
reads it. Smells everything before he trusts it.

## Personality & motivation
Dutiful, greedy, easily offended, surprisingly brave underground and a coward in the
open air. He sorts letters by smell and regards tears, blood and ale as kinds of letter.
He will follow anyone who feeds him raisins, and anyone who carries him in a pack has
his loyalty until the pack smells of goose. He would never go near a goose.

## Knowledge & secrets
- Freely shares: nothing; he is a marmot. He can be understood with *speak with animals*: "Same letter. Same bed. Same raisin. Same sigh. Nobody reads it. I'm not paid to read it."
- Needs *speak with animals* and a raisin: the post-marmots' tunnels run under the whole town and out to the glacier's foot, "where the big breathing is"; he does not use that tunnel; nobody does

## Sidekick
- **Good at:** smelling what is hidden, hollow, wet or crying (advantage on Perception by smell; finds the frozen-tear path in the glacier without a check); tunnelling through snow (burrow 5 ft); fitting through a post-hatch; being carried
- **Afraid of:** Horace (freezes, then bolts for the nearest hole), heights (will not board the ladder to Castle Lark; shakes on the ridge), and the snoring under the glacier (will not enter the cold hall)
- **Statblock:** badger (SRD): AC 10, HP 3, speed 20 ft burrow 5 ft, bite +2 (1 piercing), keen smell, darkvision 30
- **GM note, clause:** hollow-glacier → weeping-gallery → the tear-path round the slide (locations/hollow-glacier.md, Notes). Without him the cost is DC 13 Perception, or the slide into "the cave of groans" and a woken yeti. He is never the solution to the loop itself.
- **Loop:** he resets to the hatch at 06:00 unless carried in a pack at midnight, in which case he persists, remembers, and the marmot post is a marmot short: from then on the loft's letter arrives late, by a different, resentful marmot

## History with the party
(none yet)

## Movements
- 06:00–06:05 → sleeping-marmot/loft (06:02: the letter; waits for the raisin)
- 06:05–06:30 → sleeping-marmot/common-room (back down the hatch; the morning round of the town, underground)
- 06:30–00:00 → sleeping-marmot/common-room (the hatch; comes up for raisins, or with the party if adopted and fed)
